name: audio_instance_id_counter
description: GenerateNewInstanceId (0x004F7BB0) returns 1, 2, 3 and so on from a single process-wide counter at 0x00B098C0, returns the pre-increment value, and skips 0 even after a 32-bit wrap (a zero counter is forced to 1 first). There is no saturation.

steps.note: the wrap: 0xFFFFFFFF, then the counter word is 0 and is forced to 1
